d:
Watch Baby Sara mesmerize you with ‘Azhagu’ from Saivam; a honey smooth song from the eyes of a little girl. The beautiful number written by Na. Muthukumar is sung by 8 year old Uthara, daughter of singer Unnikrishnan.
Song Name - Azhagu
Movie - Saivam
Singer - Uthara
Music - G.V. Prakash Kumar
Lyrics - Na. Muthukumar
Director - Vijay
Starring - Baby Sara, Nasser
